marketMood: Geopolitical oil shock meets hawkish Fed surprise: US-Iran strikes push Brent to $97 as August's blowout jobs report lifts Fed rate-hike odds to 62%, with Asia rallying on holiday-thinned trade ahead of a pivotal week of CPI and central bank decisions.

upcomingEvents.event: US Markets Reopen After Labor Day
Bank of Japan Monetary Policy Decision

topStories.headline: August Payrolls Surge 162,000 — More Than Triple Forecasts; Fed Hike Odds Jump to 62%
topStories.summary: August nonfarm payrolls added 162,000 jobs vs. 53,000 expected, the strongest monthly gain since March, as food service and government jobs led, pushing Fed rate futures to price a 62% chance of a September hike.
topStories.marketImpact: SPY ↓, DIA ↓, QQQ ↓ on Friday close; Fed rate-hike expectations jump sharply; August CPI next week is the pivotal follow-on data point

topStories.headline: US Strikes Iranian Oil Tankers Over Weekend; Brent Crude Nears $97
topStories.summary: The US military struck three Iranian oil tankers after Tehran fired ballistic missiles at American warships in the Strait of Hormuz, escalating the conflict and renewing fears of sustained energy supply disruption.
topStories.marketImpact: Brent ↑ toward $97; WTI ↑ above $90; XOM, CVX ↑; airlines and global shipping ↓ watch; global inflation expectations tick higher

topStories.headline: Wall Street Closes Lower Friday as Rate Hike Fears Bite Before Labor Day
topStories.summary: US equities fell on the last session before the long weekend: Dow −0.51% to 53,414, S&P 500 −0.38% to 7,718, and Nasdaq −0.29% to 26,507, as the blowout jobs data revived rate-hike anxiety.
topStories.marketImpact: Broad equity ↓ on Friday; US 10Y yield at 4.79%, 30Y at 5.24%; US markets reopen Tuesday September 8

topStories.headline: BOJ Governor Ueda Signals September Rate Hike; Yen Surges 2%, Touches 155.28
topStories.summary: Bank of Japan Governor Ueda hinted at a rate hike at the September 17–18 meeting, with hawkish board member Takata calling for 'nimble' tightening potentially faster than the previous semiannual pace, sending the yen sharply higher.
topStories.marketImpact: JPY ↑ ~2% to 155.28 per USD; JGB 10Y yield at highest since August 1996; Japanese exporters like Toyota ↓ watch; rate differential vs USD narrowing

topStories.headline: Nikkei 225 Snaps Four-Day Losing Streak, Jumps 1.26% to 65,021 on Monday
topStories.summary: Japan's Nikkei 225 rebounded Monday to close at 65,021, up 1.26%, as traders rotated into domestic cyclicals and trimmed hedges after four consecutive days of losses.
topStories.marketImpact: Nikkei 225 ↑ 1.26% to 65,021; Topix ↑ 0.5% to 4,102; yen near 155.8 limits upside for exporters; domestic financials outperformed

topStories.headline: Hang Seng Edges Higher at Open; Hua Hong Semiconductor Officially Joins Blue-Chip Index
topStories.summary: Hong Kong's Hang Seng opened at 25,652 with marginal gains as Hua Hong Semiconductor entered the blue-chip index and rebounded nearly 2%, while Bilibili and NetEase each fell more than 2%.
topStories.marketImpact: 1347.HK ↑ ~2% on index-inclusion flows; 9626.HK ↓ 2%+; 9999.HK ↓ 2%+; Hang Seng Tech Index ↓ 0.3%

topStories.headline: China's August Manufacturing PMI Edges to 49.8 but Stays in Contraction; Services at 2022 Low
topStories.summary: China's official manufacturing PMI improved to 49.8 in August from 49.2, still below the 50-expansion line, while private-sector Caixin Manufacturing PMI beat at 51.5; non-manufacturing PMI held at a weak 49.0, the lowest since December 2022.
topStories.marketImpact: FXI ↓ watch; MCHI, KWEB mixed; stimulus expectations stay elevated; CNY stable; sub-50 official reading tempers risk appetite for Chinese equities

topStories.headline: South Korea's Kospi Surges 3% at Monday Open as Asia Leads in US Absence
topStories.summary: With US markets closed for Labor Day, Asia-Pacific led global equity moves; South Korea's Kospi jumped 3.09% at the open and the Kosdaq added 1.33%, led by semiconductor and energy names.
topStories.marketImpact: EWY ↑; Korea semiconductor exporters gaining; energy names benefit from oil price surge; ASX 200 flat

companiesToWatch.reason: Direct beneficiary of Brent crude surging toward $97 on renewed US-Iran Strait of Hormuz conflict, with sustained supply-risk premium in focus.

companiesToWatch.name: Chevron
companiesToWatch.reason: Major integrated energy play gaining from oil price spike driven by US-Iran escalation and constrained Hormuz shipping routes.

companiesToWatch.name: Hua Hong Semiconductor
companiesToWatch.reason: Officially joined the Hang Seng blue-chip index today, attracting passive fund inflows and momentum buying at the open.

companiesToWatch.name: Bilibili
companiesToWatch.reason: Fell more than 2% at the Hong Kong open amid broad tech selling pressure and ongoing macro uncertainty for China internet names.

companiesToWatch.name: Toyota Motor
companiesToWatch.reason: Japan's largest automaker faces direct headwinds from a sharply strengthening yen (toward 155) as BOJ rate-hike bets mount before the September 17–18 meeting.

quickHits: China's non-manufacturing PMI held at a weak 49.0 in August — its lowest since December 2022 — deepening concern about domestic demand recovery. (Trading Economics)
US Vice President Vance said Washington will not negotiate with Tehran until Iran stops targeting commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz. (CNBC)
US spot Bitcoin ETFs attracted $1.6B in net inflows last week — the strongest inflow week of 2026 — as BTC consolidates near $80K with resistance at $82,300. (BeinCrypto)
Japan's 10-year JGB yield hit its highest level since August 1996, as bond markets price in a near-certain Bank of Japan rate hike at the September 17–18 meeting. (Nikkei Asia)
